title: RDR2 DLSS / Frame Generation Mouse Bug: Mouse stops working in-game while keyboard functions normally
summary: Hey everyone, I’m running into a frustrating issue in Red Dead Redemption 2. Whenever I go into the settings and enable DLSS and Frame Generation, my mouse completely stops working once I'm in-game. My keyboard works fine (I can use menus, shortcuts, and movement keys), but the mouse cursor won't respond or look around at all. Has anyone else experienced this specific bug when turning on Frame Generation / DLSS in RDR2? If so, is there a known fix or workaround for it?

title: Setup when using fingerprints can be tedious
summary: To be able to get the fingerprint of a build script, it needs to be built so we can read the dep-info file to find the build script depedencies. The issue is that when setting up a new project for the first time, you cannot build crates that have dependencies that are not already approved. So you have to build and run `cargo guard review`, approve the crates that were built. Then rebuild to the next failure and rerun `cargo guard review` to approve the next batch of failures, and repeat until you've added everything. For large workspaces or running in a global mode this can be tedious.
